In this quest you have to kill 20 [[Scav Raiders]] on [[The Lab]] or [[Reserve]]. Then you have to visit the weapon testing area and the human experiment room in [[The Lab]]. A [[TerraGroup Labs weapon testing area key]] and a [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]] are required to enter them. The last objective needs you to obtain a secured tape from the conference room in [[The Lab]] and bring it to [[Lightkeeper]]. A [[TerraGroup Labs manager's office room key]] is required to access 3 of the 8 possible spawns in the locked manager's area. ===Weapon testing area and experiment room location=== The wanted locations are located on the first floor. You have to enter the glassed room inside the experiment area for the objective to complete.
